text:
Experiments 1-3 of 5, 2026-11-10 (Liu Hao: 'run all of them'). Numbers are posterior medians. Pull = band-summed pull/sqrt(n) in sigma, negative = model too weak. Test set = the 10 LEGA-C galaxies of results/quiescent-test-set; Mg b is in the fitted range for 5 of them, C2 4668 for 9.

1. Fixed [alpha/Fe] ladder (results/afe-ladder-floor-2026-11-10, 60/60 valid). Fixed 0.0 / +0.2 / +0.4: Mg b -4.79 / -2.95 / -2.14; C2 4668 -3.62 / -5.00 / -5.53; CN4150 -1.59 / -2.18 / -2.33; Fe4383 -0.32 / -2.26 / -3.59; G4300 +1.20 / +1.21 / +0.99; [Fe/H] -0.29 / -0.38 / -0.56; mass-weighted age 4.12 / 4.22 / 4.45 Gyr; lnZ minus free-afe lnZ -0.3 / -16.5 / -59.5. At +0.4 the Mg b pull is within 0.3 sigma of zero in 2 of 5 galaxies and -2.1 to -3.3 in the other 3. Age sensitivity: median +0.99 Gyr per dex of [alpha/Fe], range +0.08 to +5.34 (M1_210210).
2. Spectrum noise floor scaled to the data instead of the model, same 10 galaxies: paired shifts age -0.044 Gyr, [alpha/Fe] -0.002, [Fe/H] +0.003, tau_dust +0.004. The MaNGA effect (results/manga-afe-2026-11-09) does not appear on LEGA-C.
3. Free [C/Fe] and [N/Fe] (results/cn-response-2026-11-10, 78/78 valid). Implementation: alf abundance response files (Conroy+2018; public, smoothed to 100 km/s) applied as ratios at the observed resolution on the Park+2025 grid, isochrones unchanged; default off; default-off predictions are bitwise equal to the previous pin.
 LEGA-C, galaxies with Mg b in range (5): [alpha/Fe] +0.087 -> +0.296 (up in 5/5); with the carbon mask added +0.205. Mg b |pull| smaller in 4/5 (M1_210210 worse). Fitted [C/Fe] +0.18 to +0.32 in 4/5 (M1_210210 -0.05). Age 3.66 -> 3.14 Gyr (younger in 4/5); with the carbon mask added 4.20.
 LEGA-C, galaxies without Mg b in range (5): [alpha/Fe] -0.067 -> -0.154 (down in 4/5); fitted [C/Fe] -0.21 to -0.26 in 4/5; age 4.22 -> 4.80 Gyr (older in 4/5).
 LEGA-C, all 10: Mg b -4.13 -> -2.24; C2 4668 -3.59 -> -2.97 (|pull| smaller in 6/9); CN4150 -1.57 -> -0.71. Carbon mask on top of free C/N shifts [alpha/Fe] by +0.029 (all 10), +0.016 (Mg b five); the mask alone shifted it by +0.128 on the same 10 (results/carbon-mask-2026-11-08). Straight-line age-redshift slope on the 10: baseline +1.2, C/N +4.0, C/N + mask +0.9 Gyr per unit z (10 galaxies; the earlier bootstrap on this set gave +-1.5 to +-2.7).
 MaNGA rest 3860-5330 A window (8): [alpha/Fe] +0.138 -> +0.226 (paired +0.097, up in 8/8); age paired -1.09 Gyr (younger in 8/8); carbon mask on top: [alpha/Fe] +0.025, age +1.52 Gyr (older in 8/8). C2 4668 -8.39 -> -7.39.
 MaNGA full range (8): [alpha/Fe] +0.199 -> +0.361 (up in 8/8); age 9.35 -> 10.48 Gyr; lnZ gain median about +130; tau_dust stays at the prior edge (0.99) in every arm.

Not tested yet: mocks with injected C/N (experiment 4, running); the age-redshift slope on all 135 for C/N free, C/N free with fixed [alpha/Fe], carbon mask, and a common rest-frame range (experiment 5, running, results/chronometer-135-2026-11-10); why fitted [C/Fe] changes sign with Mg b coverage; M8_161113 fitted [N/Fe] +0.75.
